title: United Group of Companies
description:
Construction | Troy, New York, United States | Since 1972, The United Group of Companies, Inc. has specialized in all phases of real estate: development, financing, construction, and management. Their specialties include independent senior living, student apartment communities, multi-family (including affordable) housing, commercial properties, and mixed-use neighborhoods. The United Group of Companies is headquartered out of Troy, New York. 
The company headquarters is located in 300 Jordan Road, Troy, NY 12180, United States. 201-500 Employees
